# Aura Civic Establishment

A proposed 24/7 shared civic establishment in Brisbane by Luke Nathan Hayes / Strange But True. 433 Logan Road, Stones Corner is a candidate location. Programmes are selected overlaps within a wider ecosystem. Calculator outputs are editable planning scenarios. Personal Auras belong to their people; C-Hour has no monetary equivalent.

Read the dated source context and preserve distinctions between historic evidence, author proposals, scenario assumptions and operating arrangements. Discovery does not grant commercial or AI-training rights.
